citation: Moschoglou et al. (2017), AgeDB: the first manually collected, in-the-wild age database.
selection: 104 different dataset identities; exact ages matched to the supplied pilot manifest. Scarce ages allocated first; prefer JPEG files >=10 KB, then a deterministic SHA-256 ordering. No model predictions were collected.
terms: Non-commercial research; internal use within one organization. See the official page for copying and redistribution restrictions.
